baseline: single GPU, AE waits for latest VLM cache (fresh_cache)
baseline_time_definition: sum(measurement seconds) / sum(completed AE chunks): steady completion period, not input-to-action latency
g_time_definition: native total_us / 1e6: one combined pair completion time, not a multi-frame steady-state measurement
GPU_proxy_application: fresh_cache measured GPU average reused as a constant throughout the full g interval
